docker network create --driver bridge dojo-isolated creates a new isolated bridge with its own subnet and iptables rules — containers on it cannot reach containers on other bridges by default

docker network disconnect dojo-shared dojo-internal-api then docker network connect dojo-isolated dojo-internal-api — test isolation with: docker exec dojo-payments ping -c 1 dojo-internal-api (should fail)
kubectl patch configmap network-proof -n dojo-docker-bridge -p '{"data":{"isolated_network":"dojo-isolated"}}' to record the proof
